evals.prompt: Review an enrichment change that merges a phrasal verb and its base verb into one returned item.
evals.expected_output: Flags collapsing distinct senses; one returned item must be one distinct sense, and phrasal verbs/idioms/fixed phrases stay separate (ADR 0008); suggests edge-case tests before broad prompt or schema changes.

evals.prompt: Review code that stores dictionary verification evidence and reuses it as LLM context.
evals.expected_output: Requires honoring verification license flags before storing or using evidence (ADR 0007, ADR 0009); separates dictionary verification from AI generation; keeps shared/ai/core provider- and feature-agnostic.
